candidates.title: Move sign-in after pet adoption
candidates.change: Defer account sign-in until after users choose and customize their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users right away; letting users pick their pet first builds emotional connection before requiring account setup.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to after pet adoption is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High sign_in drop-off (27.1%); deferring auth is a proven friction reducer but requires flow engineering.

candidates.title: Interactive pet preview cards
candidates.change: Redesign pet selection with a split layout showing animated pet previews and sound clips.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 39.1% of users and takes 89s median, indicating users need clearer visuals of what their desktop pet will do.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop controls quick guide
candidates.change: Insert a new onboarding step showing how to click, move, hide, and interact with the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent post-onboarding confusion tickets from users unsure how to control or hide their new desktop pet.

new_desktop_guide.headline: How to interact with your desktop pet
new_desktop_guide.body: Click to pet, right-click for options, or drag to reposition anywhere on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adding a desktop controls guide screen within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops 35.2% and support explicitly reports post-onboarding control confusion; adding a screen is costly.

candidates.title: Interactive waiting room with ready alert
candidates.change: Transform waiting time into an interactive mini-pet preview arena with progress timer and background completion alerts.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and 18.7% drop-off while pet generation renders.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen while keeping progress info for a real wait is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home wait step has 18.7% drop-off and high mean time (2336s); high build cost for custom mini-game flow.

candidates.title: Existing account account recovery hint
candidates.change: Display an informative prompt on sign-in clarifying how returning users can recover previously adopted pets.
candidates.why: Support logged 8 emails from users who lost or reset pets after inadvertently creating a new account during sign-in.

sign_in.hint: Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore your pet and progress.

guard.reason: Adding account recovery copy to the sign-in step is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and 8 support tickets highlight sign-in confusion; cheap text/hint fix but affects small user segment.

candidates.title: Grid layout for creation path selection
candidates.change: Switch path selection to a structured grid layout clearly separating ready-to-adopt pets from photo creation.
candidates.why: Users take an average of 514s on choose_path, suggesting confusion between standard adoption and custom creation paths.

choose_path.headline: How would you like to meet your pet?

guard.reason: Updating layout while preserving both adopt and make-your-own options maintains the screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path loses 23.8% with an unusually long 514s mean time; grid layout simplifies decision hierarchy.

candidates.title: Photo upload quality tips
candidates.change: Add photo guidelines and delayed tip popups detailing supported photo lighting and angles.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 tickets where custom pet photo generation failed or generated incorrect visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Upload a clear, front-facing photo with good lighting for best custom pet generation results.

candidates.title: Onboarding completion reward item
candidates.change: Display a desktop pet toy badge reward granted upon completing the final onboarding setup.
candidates.why: Completion drops off at finish (64.8% conversion, 395s median), needing extra motivation to complete onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your pet is ready for your desktop!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy explicitly mentions 'Free', violating Rule 3 which prohibits mentioning prices, gifts, or free extras.

candidates.title: Action-oriented intro call-to-action
candidates.change: Update story screen headline and button text to emphasize quick 2-minute adoption.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off on the initial choose_path / story transition.

story.headline: Adopt an animated pet for your desktop in under 2 minutes

guard.reason: Updating story headline and call-to-action text is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets initial step drop-off (23.8%) with simple copy tweak.

candidates.title: Background generation desktop alert
candidates.change: Prompt users on waiting screen that they can safely minimize the app and get notified when ready.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s as users tab away to other applications.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window! We will notify you when your pet is ready on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding background notification guidance to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long tail home step wait time (2336s mean) by encouraging safe backgrounding via desktop alert.

held_by_harm_budget: Interactive waiting room with ready alert
